Name: Quest Framework (obsolete)
Author: purrplingcat
Description:
[b][center][/center][/b][b][left][/left][/b][left][b][size=6]Quest Framework[/size]

Quest framework[/b] is a Stardew Valley framework mod that provides a tool for modders.
It allows modders to create custom quests, define custom quest types and handle quests on the backend.
It supports Content Packs and SMAPI mod-provided API.

[size=4][b][/b][quote][b]This mod is OBSOLETE since SDV 1.6[/b]

This mod is available only for older SDV version 1.5. No active maintenance, no future updates.[/quote][/size]
[b][size=4]For players:[/size][/b]

[size=3][u]Install[/u][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]latest version of SMAPI[/url]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6414]this mod from nexus mods[/url]﻿
[*]Unpack Quest Framework to the [code]Mods[/code] folder
[*]Unpack Quest Framework's content packs to the [code]Mods[/code]

folder (follow the pack's instructions)
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[size=3][u]Requirements[/u][/size]

[list]
[*]SMAPI version 3.9.0 or newer
[*]Stardew Valley 1.5
[/list]
[size=3][u]Compatibility[/u][/size]

[color=#00ff00]✔️[/color] Quest Framework is [b]mostly[/b] compatible with Stardew Valley 1.5+ on [b]Linux/Mac/Windows[/b], both single-player and multiplayer.
[b][color=#ff0000] [/color][color=#f1c232]⚠ Partialy compatible with local-split screen (QF 1.4 beta and newer), but can cause some issues in rare cases.[/color]
[color=#cc0000]✖️ [/color][color=#ff0000]Not compatible with Android SDV (since SDV 1.5 was released but it's not available for mobile)[/color]
[/b]

Compatible with [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url][/b].

Compatibility with [b]Android[/b] version of SMAPI/SDV is [b]not not possible [/b]since SDV 1.5 is released only for PC and consoles.

[b][size=4][/size][/b][b][size=4]FOR MODDERS
[/size][/b]
[size=3][u]Content Pack API[/u][/size]

You can create content packs which adds your custom quests. Options for added quests by this way are limited. For more advanced stuffs with quests use advanced API.

To create JSON content pack see [url=https://questframework.purrplingcat.com/docs/content-pack-guide.html]Content Pack API guide[/url].

[size=3][u]Advanced API[/u][/size]
﻿
With advanced API you can create more complex and advanced quests, create quest observers, custom quest types and more. Using advanced API requires programming skills in C# and knowledge of SMAPI modding.

How to use advanced API see [url=https://questframework.purrplingcat.com/docs/advanced-api-guide.html]Advanced API guide[/url].
